Will a power station run a mini fridge, and for how long?

Scenarios Updated 2026-08-08

The running load is trivial and the start is not. A 4.5 cu ft compact fridge carries a rating plate of 161 VA, which is under a tenth of most machines’ continuous output, but the compressor inside it has a locked-rotor rating of 2,530 VA for a fifth of a second. Of the 12 published US machines in this library, 4 refuse this load and 1 is downgraded — every one of them on the start-up, none of them on running watts.

For how long is the harder half, and this site will not give you an hour figure for it. The rating plate is an apparent-power ceiling rather than a measured draw, and the certified annual energy for this class works out at an average of about 26 W — two numbers from two different test conditions, which is why multiplying either one by a battery would produce a confident answer to nothing.

Two published numbers, and neither one is what you think

What a compact fridge publishes

Both running rows are rating-plate amperes times nominal voltage, so they are volt-amperes, not measured watts. The start-up row comes from the compressor’s own component data sheet, because whole-appliance rating plates do not carry it.

This is the cleanest example on the site of why a verdict has to be computed rather than looked up. Every one of those rows would pass a comparison of running watts against continuous output, and four of the twelve fail anyway. It is also why buying by capacity alone goes wrong at the small end: a 300 Wh machine can hold a compact fridge for hours once it is turning, and never get it turning.

Why there is no hour figure on this page

Ask any calculator how long a battery runs a mini fridge and it will multiply the rating plate by a duty cycle. We did that too, and it was wrong by a factor of five. The duty cycle on this record used to be 0.85, borrowed from a manufacturer’s statement about full-size refrigerators. Against the rating plate that implies about 1,199 kWh a year, while the certification database lists 226–228 kWh for twenty-nine compact models of this capacity. The figure was corrected on 2026-08-03 and the duty cycle recomputed to 0.18, but the gate on hour figures stayed shut, because the two remaining terms still come from different test conditions: a rating plate is apparent power declared by the maker, and the certified annual energy is measured behind a closed door at a fixed ambient temperature.

What the engine says instead of an hour

Asked for a runtime on this load, our engine returns a withheld result naming the field it is waiting on — load.duty_cycle — rather than a number. That is the whole mechanism: a figure this site cannot defend does not get a smaller font, it gets no print at all. If you want your own answer, the honest route is to time your own fridge over an hour of ordinary use and put that duty cycle into the calculator yourself.

The limit that bites first outdoors

One manufacturer’s manual for this class states a recommended operating ambient of 7 °C to 43 °C, out of direct sunlight. A closed vehicle in summer and an unshaded pitch both clear the top of that range easily, and when they do it is the fridge that stops coping, not the battery. Defrost type matters too: the same database lists 268 kWh a year for the automatic-defrost versions of the same capacity against 228 kWh for the manual ones, so check which one you own before sizing anything.

Questions people ask

Can a power station run a mini fridge?
It depends entirely on the start-up, not the running watts. Of the twelve published US machines in this library, four refuse a 4.5 cu ft compact fridge and one is downgraded — all of them on the compressor’s 2,530 VA locked-rotor start, none on continuous output, where the load is under 11 percent everywhere. Machines that clear the start hold it comfortably afterwards.
How many watts does a mini fridge use?
The rating plate on a 4.5 cu ft model reads 1.4 A at 115 V, which is 161 VA — a declared ceiling in apparent power, not a measured draw. Over a certified year the same class averages about 26 W, because the compressor is switched off most of the time. A 2.4 cu ft model’s plate reads 0.7 A, or 80.5 VA.
How long will a power station run a mini fridge?
We do not publish an hour figure for this load, and the reason is on the record. The two numbers you would multiply come from different test conditions: the rating plate is apparent power declared by the manufacturer, and the certified annual energy is measured in a closed-door standard test. Our own earlier attempt, using a duty cycle borrowed from full-size refrigerators, was off by a factor of five. Time your own fridge and put that duty cycle into the calculator instead.
